description: This PHP source file defines the Handling class for managing order handling fees within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It calculates total handling fees, applies taxes if configured, and updates the order's totals and taxes accordingly.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating and applying handling fees to the cart total.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the handling fee total, applies taxes if configured, and updates totals and taxes arrays.
